entities.summary: Timocharis of Alexandria was a Greek astronomer and philosopher, likely born in Alexandria, who made significant contributions to the field of astronomy during the Classical era. He was a contemporary of Euclid and is believed to have written works on the subject. Timocharis' work on astronomy helped to lay the foundations for future developments in the field, including the work of later Greek astronomers. His contributions had a lasting impact on the development of astronomy, shaping the understanding of the natural world for centuries to come. Timocharis' legacy can be seen in the work of later astronomers, who built upon his discoveries and expanded our understanding of the universe. He remains an important figure in the history of astronomy, highlighting the significance of the Classical era in the development of scientific knowledge.
